visual_logic.subject_appearance: Solid black silhouette of a basal parareptile. Long snout, slender body, and deep, powerful tail.
visual_logic.environment: Dark, stagnant 'Brackish Water' with high organic content.
visual_logic.backlight_strategy: DUSK_SILHOUETTE; sun on the horizon creates a high-contrast orange background.
visual_logic.facial_silhouette: Elongated rostrum with hints of the needle-like teeth visible as a serrated edge on the silhouette.

pose: Mid-water strike pose; neck slightly arched and tail beginning a powerful lateral sweep.
negative_constraints: Avoid blurring the 'tooth-comb' silhouette; the snout edges must remain crisp.
